# DOT Hazmat Function Specific Training: Markings

> 2-hour online function-specific training for hazmat employers and employees who apply and verify DOT markings on hazardous materials packages, under 49 CFR Part 172 Subpart D. Available in English and Spanish. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 2 hours; 2 modules, 3 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.2 CEU
- Price: $39.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7; SCORM, virtual instructor-led and in-person formats also available
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Prerequisites: none
- Certificate: downloadable on passing; valid 3 years

## Topics
- General marking requirements for bulk and non-bulk packaging
- Identification numbers
- Hazardous substances and hazardous wastes
- Marine pollutants
- Limited quantities
- Non-bulk packaging of liquid hazardous materials
- Class-specific marks: radioactive, poisonous and infectious materials

## Lessons
1. Regulatory Overview
2. General Marking Requirements
3. Specific Marking Requirements

## Who should take it
Hazmat employees who apply or verify markings; shippers; shipping, receiving and warehouse staff; packaging design, manufacture and testing personnel; carriers, logistics staff and freight forwarders; safety and compliance personnel.
